comparison.interpretation: The released ReSOT mapping is collision-free, but its depth-1 prefixes preserve less train-only co-occurrence structure than a deterministic category-prefix control on the same data.

control_role: deterministic same-dataset interpretation control; not a named tokenizer row

protocol.category_path: comma-separated metadata category; common leading path removed
protocol.leaf_level: item-id-sorted ordinal within the three-level category prefix
protocol.prefix_levels: first three remaining hierarchical category segments, lexicographically encoded within parent
